column2: What is CEL? Community Energy Lab
What are the types of renewable energy resources? Hydrogen, biomass, biogas, geothermal, solar, wind
Who are the consumers? Citizens, stakeholders, local authorities, SMEs.
Which kind of buildings are in the community? School, households, residential buildings, industrial, oil mills, wineries, municipal facilities.
What can be monitored in buildings? Energy consumption, thermal performance, indoor air quality
What type of weather data is collected for building energy analysis? Temperature, humidity, solar radiation, barometric pressure, dew point
What are the possible types of weather? Warm climate, hotter summers, mild winters, High wind potential
How are energy production and consumption balanced to avoid energy waste? efficient energy management, storage systems, real-time data monitoring.
What is DPsim? Dynamic Phasor simulation
What is CIM? Common Information Model
What are the units of measurement for the energy demand? MW, kW
How is the indoor space heating provided? Geo-exchange plant
How is the indoor space cooling provided? Geo-exchange plant
How is the electricity provided? PV
How is the disposed heat from indoor space cooling utilized? Heat recovery systems
Is indoor space heating or cooling needed? Indoor space cooling
